_readme: Caption looks: how the words on screen look and move. A look is a SETTING — switching it never re-edits the footage. Sizes are for a 1080-wide frame. `y_pct` is where the line's centre sits, measured down from the top; it must clear the safe zone. `match-swipe` is not a row: it means build a one-off look from the teardown's caption read (font weight, case, colour, highlight, position). Only Damon signs a row approved.

looks.name: Bold highlight
looks.what: Big white capitals with a black outline, 2–4 words at a time, the word being spoken turns yellow and pops.

looks.name: Clean lower
looks.what: Sentence-case white words on a soft dark plate, low in the frame. Reads like a subtitle, not a shout.

looks.name: One word
looks.what: One huge word at a time, dead centre. For hooks and fast cuts.
